rows.grounds: prasiddha modifies liṅgānāṃ; genitive plural masculine/neuter
trayaḥ+triṃśat forms thirty-three; udāhṛtam is passive participle declared; neuter nominative singular

items.question: What is the declared number of famous liṅgas?
items.inference: The verse declares thirty-three famous liṅgas.
uncertainties: whether liṅga here means physical sign or ritual form
